newsitem.title: GREECE: Strintzis says 96 net up 20 pct, ups div.
newsitem.headline: Strintzis says 96 net up 20 pct, ups div.

text.p: Strintzis Sea Lines said its fiscal 1996 net rose 20 percent to 2.533 billion drachmas from 2.1 billion a year earlier.
The company will also raise its 1996 dividend per share to 70 drachmas from 60 in 1995.
Strintzis, active in the Greece-Italy, Ireland-UK, Rafina-Cyclades and Ionian islands sea routes will launch a new Catamaran, 40-knot, passenger vessel in the Saronic gulf in 1998, it said.
Its shares were down two drachmas at 978 in late session Tuesday. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
